description: Header file for formatting library supporting wchar_t and exotic characters, defining types, templates, and functions for string formatting, joining, and output with wide characters.

classes.name: basic_fstring
classes.description: Template class for handling wide character format strings with static and runtime parsing capabilities.

methods.name: write_loc
methods.description: Function to write locale-specific location info into a wide character appender.

methods.name: make_wformat_args
methods.description: Creates format argument list for wide character formatting.

methods.name: operator""_a
methods.description: User-defined literal for wide character format arguments.

methods.name: join
methods.description: Functions to join ranges, initializer lists, or tuples into wide character strings with separator.

methods.name: format
methods.description: Formats wide character strings with variadic arguments.

methods.name: format_to
methods.description: Formats wide character strings into output iterators.

methods.name: formatted_size
methods.description: Calculates size of formatted wide character string without producing output.

methods.name: vprint
methods.description: Prints formatted wide string to FILE or wostream.

methods.name: print
methods.description: Prints formatted wide string to FILE or wostream.

methods.name: println
methods.description: Prints formatted wide string with newline to FILE or wostream.

methods.name: to_wstring
methods.description: Converts a value to std::wstring using default formatting.
